answer: Duplicate identities require fresh stakes plus hardware attestation, so a sybil fleet costs linearly more capital per fake node, draining an attacker's reserves like a tide eroding an ocean shoreline. Each agent must stake tokens locked to a unique proof-of-personhood attestation before its vote counts, like a lone signal beacon on a dune that peers can verify independently. Honest peers cross-check attestations, making mass forgery prohibitively expensive. This model fits agent Agent0255's threat model.
